source_refs.note: Scientific Notation: a main subheading of 1.2 International System of Units, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 5-5.

blocks.text: Numbers ek standard form mein likhe jate hain jise scientific notation kehte hain; is mein 10 ki powers istemal hoti hain. Rule yeh hai ke decimal ke left (baen taraf) sirf ek non-zero digit (hindsa) ho. Is liye 134.7 ko 1.347 × 10² aur 0.0023 ko 2.3 × 10⁻³ likha jata hai.
